meta.title: skwrit Component Map
meta.subtitle: The skwrit matter engine worker as an optional SKStacks role: what calls it, what it depends on, and where it publishes

boundaries.label: optional/skwrit role: private Docker Swarm overlay network, never the public internet

connections.label: composer and reviewer endpoints, configured separately
AI tooling reaches the Nextcloud side

cards.title: Pipeline
items: draft -> quality gate -> independent review -> release -> publish into skhub -> re-download check
The reviewer model and endpoint are configured separately from the composer, so one model never grades its own homework by default

cards.title: Deployment
items: Optional SKStacks role (optional/skwrit): one worker replica, port 8080, stop-first updates
Deploys a pinned container image built per site and refuses to run without a full @sha256 digest
/health reports the corpus, the quality gate, and the render assets, not just process up

cards.title: Boundaries
items: Every credential is an external Docker Swarm secret, referenced by name only
Called by skflow over a private overlay network, never over the public internet
Optional vector store and embeddings endpoints stay fleet-owned
Not yet folded into the skstack06 lab gate; that is planned, not shipped
